questions.prompt: Your household needs another season of your labor, but a rare chance to leave arrives tomorrow. What do you do?

answers.label: Stay and honor the duty first.
Seize the chance and accept the cost at home.

questions.prompt: You catch a starving stranger stealing from your stores. What do you do?

answers.label: Feed them once and warn them never to return.
Drive them off hard so others learn the lesson.

questions.prompt: An elder's method fails. A risky new approach might work. What do you choose?

answers.label: Try the new way despite the risk.

questions.prompt: A partner cheats you by a small sum you can prove. What matters more?

answers.label: Recover every coin, even if it burns the relationship.
Keep your name clean and walk away with dignity.

questions.prompt: A difficult road lies ahead. Do you prefer to face it alone or bind allies early?

answers.label: Seek trustworthy allies before the hard miles.
